BEGIN DOMAIN
(define (domain blocksworld-4ops)
(:requirements :strips)
(:types block)
(:predicates
(on ?x ?y)
(on-table ?x)
(clear ?x)
(arm-empty)
(holding ?x)
)

(:action pickup
:parameters (?ob)
:precondition (and (clear ?ob) (on-table ?ob) (arm-empty))
:effect (and (holding ?ob) (not (on-table ?ob)) (not (clear ?ob)) (not (arm-empty))))

(:action putdown
:parameters (?ob)
:precondition (holding ?ob)
:effect (and (arm-empty) (on-table ?ob) (clear ?ob) (not (holding ?ob))))

(:action stack
:parameters (?ob ?underob)
:precondition (and (holding ?ob) (clear ?underob))
:effect (and (arm-empty) (on ?ob ?underob) (clear ?ob) (not (clear ?underob)) (not (holding ?ob))))

(:action unstack
:parameters (?ob ?underob)
:precondition (and (on ?ob ?underob) (clear ?ob) (arm-empty))
:effect (and (holding ?ob) (clear ?underob) (not (on ?ob ?underob)) (not (clear ?ob)) (not (arm-empty))))
)
END DOMAIN
